PTDECOR American Flag Dog Bandana vs Blueberry Pet — Which Patriotic Scarf Wins?

Two popular dog bandanas go head-to-head: the PTDECOR reversible American flag triangle scarf ($14.99) versus the Blueberry Pet adjustable patterned bandana ($12.99). We test fabric, fit, durability, and style.

Published October 25, 2026 · Based on verified Amazon product data and real customer reviews

Dressing up your dog isn't just a holiday affair — the right bandana turns a regular walk into a statement, keeps your pup looking sharp in photos, and can even help strangers identify a friendly dog from a distance. Whether you're prepping for a 4th of July barbecue, a Memorial Day parade, or just want your Labrador to look as American as apple pie on a Tuesday, a good dog bandana is a staple accessory.

Today we're comparing two of Amazon's most popular dog bandanas: the PTDECOR Reversible American Flag Triangle Dog Scarf ($14.99) and the Blueberry Pet Adjustable Patterned Dog Bandana ($12.99). Both are well-reviewed, both come from established brands, but they take very different approaches to canine neckwear. Let's find out which one deserves a spot in your dog's wardrobe.

Meet the Contenders

PTDECOR American Flag Reversible Dog Bandana Our Pick

$14.99

The PTDECOR American Flag Dog Bandana is a reversible triangle scarf designed for medium and large dogs. One side features a bold, full-coverage American flag print with crisp stars and stripes; the reverse is a solid navy blue — giving you two looks in one accessory. It uses a simple tie-on design that wraps around your dog's neck and knots securely, with no buckles, velcro, or snaps to fuss with. The fabric is a soft cotton-poly blend that's machine-washable and resists fading through multiple cycles.

Owners of Golden Retrievers, German Shepherds, Pit Bulls, Boxers, and similar-sized breeds consistently report a great fit. The generous triangle shape gives full neck coverage without restricting movement, and the double-layer design adds a bit of warmth for cooler mornings.

Blueberry Pet Adjustable Patterned Dog Bandana

$12.99

Blueberry Pet is a well-known name in dog fashion, and their adjustable dog bandana comes in dozens of patterns — from classic plaid and floral to seasonal pumpkin and snowflake designs. This model uses an adjustable slide mechanism: a plastic tri- glide buckle lets you tighten or loosen the collar-loop section to fit neck circumferences from roughly 11 to 22 inches, covering everything from Corgis to Golden Retrievers. The fabric is a lightweight 100% cotton with a tight weave that prints patterns vividly.

It's designed as an over-the-collar bandana, meaning you thread your dog's existing collar through the fabric loop at the top. This keeps the bandana from sliding around during walks and prevents it from coming untied — a common complaint with traditional tie-on styles.

Fabric and Comfort: Cotton-Poly vs Pure Cotton

The PTDECOR's cotton-poly blend hits a sweet spot: it feals softer than straight cotton out of the package and the synthetic fibers help the colors hold up through dozens of washes. Owners report that — unlike cheap bandanas that turn pink after two cycles — the PTDECOR's red and blue stay vibrant even after a full summer of weekly laundering. The poly content also means it dries faster after a rainy walk.

Blueberry Pet's 100% cotton will appeal to owners who prefer natural fibers against their dog's skin, especially for dogs with sensitivities. Cotton breathes better in hot weather, which matters if you're attending a July parade in 90°F heat. The tradeoff: the cotton-only bandana wrinkles after washing and the pattern can fade slightly faster than a blend, particularly on darker designs.

Pro Tip: For dogs that like to roll in puddles or mud, the PTDECOR's poly-blend fabric shakes off dirt more easily than the Blueberry's pure cotton, which tends to hold onto grime until washed.

Fit and Security: Which Stays Put?

This is where the two bandanas diverge most sharply — and the decision really comes down to your dog's behavior.

The PTDECOR uses a traditional tie-on. You wrap the bandana around your dog's neck and knot it at the side or front. It's simple, classic, and there are no hardware pieces that can break. The downside? If your dog is a wrestler — rolling, scratching at their neck, roughousing with other dogs — that knot can come loose. And some owners find themselves re-tying it every hour on particularly active dogs.

The Blueberry Pet uses a collar-thread design. You slide your dog's existing collar through a fabric loop at the top of the bandana. Because it's physically attached to the collar, the bandana cannot fall off, untie, or slide around — period. For dogs that run through brush, wrestle, or swim, this is a game-changer. The tri-glide buckle lets you adjust the loop width for your dog's collar thickness and neck size, giving a custom fit for everything from a slender Whippet to a thick-necked Rottweiler.

Style and Occasion Versatility

The PTDECOR is unabashedly patriotic — that's its whole identity. The American flag print is bold and photographed really well. On a sunny day, that flag pops against dark or light-colored fur alike. The solid navy reverse side is a thoughtful touch: flip it around for a subtler look when you're just heading to the dog park and don't want the full star-spangled treatment. The reversible design effectively gives you two bandanas for the price of one, and the transition between looks is instant — just flip and tie.

The Blueberry Pet counters with pure variety. With 30+ patterns — plaids, florals, holiday themes, camo, tie-dye — you can swap bandanas to match any occasion or mood. This is the better choice if you want a different look for fall, Christmas, St. Patrick's Day, game day, and everyday walks. However, at $12.99 each, building a collection adds up. Blueberry Pet also occasionally runs multi-pack deals, which can bring the per-unit cost close to $9.

Durability and Longevity

Both bandanas are well-constructed, but they wear differently over time. The PTDECOR's double-layer reversible construction makes it inherently more durable — even if one layer snags, the other is still intact. The reinforced hem stitching along all four edges prevents fraying after repeated wash cycles. Owners frequently report their PTDECOR bandana still looks nearly new after 6-12 months of regular use.

The Blueberry Pet bandana is single-layer, so it's lighter and cooler but more vulnerable to wear. The edges are simply hemmed without reinforcement, and some owners note that the thread binding around the collar loop area can start to fray after 4-6 months on especially active dogs. That said, at this price point, many owners are fine replacing it seasonally.

Value for Money

At $14.99 for the PTDECOR versus $12.99 for the Blueberry Pet, the price difference is negligible — we're talking about $2. But value isn't just about price.

The PTDECOR effectively gives you two looks (flag and solid navy), making it the better value if you want a reversible design that works beyond a single holiday. The Blueberry Pet's value comes from its fit reliability and pattern selection — you're paying for a bandana that stays on and matches your exact style preference.

🏆 Final Verdict: Our Pick

For medium and large dog owners who want a bold, well-made patriotic bandana with a reversible design, the PTDECOR American Flag Dog Bandana is the clear winner. The cotton-poly blend holds color beautifully, the double-layer construction doubles the lifespan, and the reversible navy side turns it from holiday accessory into an everyday staple. At $14.99 with Prime delivery, it's a small price for something your dog will wear with pride.

Choose Blueberry Pet if: you have a small dog, you want pattern variety, or your dog is an escape artist who needs a collar-threaded design that absolutely will not come loose.

Choose the PTDECOR if: you have a medium or large dog, you love the reversible two-in-one value, and you want a bandana that still looks stellar after a year of washes.
